BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Brass Dragon Reguita!!
W-who the heck are you?!
Why are you doing this?
It's none of your business...\nOh, perhaps it will eventually be your\nbusiness too. In that case, let me tell you...
God doesn't exist in this world, so there should\nnot be any problem if our leader, the\nImperial Dragon becomes the supreme ruler here...
Now we're working to make that happen.
But the inhabitants of this world won't like your\nselfish decision!
Who cares...We'll just wipe out those who don't \nlike it!
What...? No one deserves to be killed by you\nno matter who they are!!
Mwahaha! What can a mere weredragon and\nweak-looking creatures do?
Are you sure I'm weak? Try me!
Hey, don't steal my thunder!!
You got Silver Nugget!
Aah...Aaaaah! H-how dare you...\nHow dare you crush our hope!
Stop it!
My lover lost his life because the minions of the\nImperial Dragon talked him into doing what they\nwanted...
They made weredragons fight each other after\nanalyzing their relationship...I've seen enough\nweredragons die because of that!
Zianga, are you okay?!
What took you guys so long?
Oh?!
Hey, what do you think you're doing?!
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing. Let's go back!
Explore Boma Konda a little longer!
You apologize to the village chief for having the\nguardian deity taken away...
Oh, it's fine. The guardian deity of this village\nhas been a part of our community for ages, but its\norigin is unclear.
It doesn't possess any exceptional powers, so\ndon't worry about it.
Then why did you let that guy have it and escape?
The Imperial Dragon faction has no reason to raid\na poor village like this. Should there be anything\nnoteworthy, it must be the guardian deity.
It's not like it has any special powers.\nIt's just I don't think it's a good idea to\nlet them have it...
I, I don't understand your logic...Letting him have\nsomething like that would put him in danger.\nPoor guy...
Since it doesn't have any special powers, I wonder\nwhy he took it.
There's something that worries me more...\nThe minions of the Imperial Dragon are targeting\nthe royal dragon cocoon!
While I was held captive, I learned that the\ndragons of the Imperial Dragon faction want to\ndestroy the royal dragon cocoon and
make the Imperial Dragon the ruler of dragons, and\nultimately the ruler of this world...\nPlease stop them as soon as possible!
But the Imperial Dragon seemed to be protecting\nthe weredragons' vital point and watching the\ncocoon grow...Why are they acting like this?
Is there something on your mind?\nOh my...! You should know that not all of the\nImperial Dragon's minions think the same way.
Only some close ones truly understand the Imperial\nDragon, while the rest are mostly terrible guys\nthat would do anything to get on his good side.
So it's not a surprise if there are some dragons\nthat think differently from the Imperial Dragon\nwhen it comes to what to do with the cocoon...
Oh no, the royal dragon cocoon is in danger!
Thanks for everything so far. I have to go now.\nSee ya!
Hey, wait! You know where the royal dragon cocoon\nis?! It wasn't in the weredragons' vital point,\nwas it?
Uh, um, well...Chief, do you have any information?
I don't know if it's true, but someone claimed to\nhave seen something like a giant egg in the ice at\nthe Frozen Falls beyond Jabali Kubwa.
The Frozen Falls?! I got it!!
This is a problem between the dragons and the\nweredragons. It has nothing to do with you...\nI'll take care of it on my own from here on...
But we've been heavily involved in all of this\nwithout receiving any reward. We can't simply\nsay bye at this point, you know~!
So what I'm trying to say is we follow you till\nthe end!
Guess I can do nothing about it!
